drafted_from: workflow:personalized-reach-out's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its job, input schema and the step named in the worked example)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:personalized-reach-out: thank the three people who commented on my bakery video, by reply only, with nothing sent without my approval."
no_lists_because: It finds people from the person's own comment threads, messages and customer records and keeps its evidence in the run itself, so it ships no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Write the request, the scope (who counts as relevant), the constraints (what not to do) and the authorized actions (for example "reply in the same thread"); all four are required.
2. Say "Run workflow:personalized-reach-out" with them. It works through fit, message, deliver and follow.
3. At fit, it verifies each person's identity, source, relationship and channel and reviews the Marketplace for useful tools; evidence is kept with an id, a source and what was observed.

4. At message, write each message to be individually useful and truthful; respect opt-outs and suppression lists. At deliver, send only inside the authorized actions and read the delivery state back; at follow, answer real replies only.

worked_examples.title: Find the relevant people from their own comments
worked_examples.ask: Run workflow:personalized-reach-out: thank the three people who commented on my bakery video, by reply only.

input.request: Thank the three people who commented on my bakery video with a useful reply
input.scope: People who commented on my latest video, https://example.com/video/bake-day
constraints: Do not contact anyone who opted out
authorized_actions: Draft replies in the same comment thread
